resources.string: Blocks the apps and websites you choose in Hít Đất AI until you earn time with a workout, and counts that time down while you use them. It checks which app is open and, in a browser, the domain of the page; it does not read anything else on the screen, your messages or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone. When your time runs out it may go back, go to the home screen or close a blocked app\'s picture-in-picture window.
